prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 20 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1471; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred during a lane change, with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with a whiplash-type mechanism. The reported symptoms are in keeping with the kind and force of the impact described. Over the course of twenty visits, care consisted of manual therapy, guided range-of-motion exercises, and a home stretching program, following a typical and expected progression. Pain and mobility improved steadily, and visit frequency was reduced accordingly as symptoms resolved. Physical examination revealed reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness, which support the reported injury. Other neurological screening and imaging-related assessments were within normal limits. The patient mentioned a remote, minor strain to the same region years ago, which had fully resolved without lasting limitation. Billing records reflect single, appropriately spaced charges for each service with no duplicated entries. At discharge, the patient was improved, with residual stiffness only at end range and a plan for self-directed exercise.
